title: Detached Runtime Execution Evidence
summary: The registry provides a detached snapshot of the execution environment (generation, artifact, etc.) that is separate from the mutable generation object.
why: Allows a request to prove exactly which code executed the work without exposing lifecycle authority or being affected by later generation changes.
invariants: RuntimeExecutionEvidence contains metadata only; it has no lifecycle methods.
An evidence snapshot captured while ACTIVE remains ACTIVE forever as historical evidence, even if the generation later drains.
The evidence is detached from the mutable RuntimeGeneration.
